title: Households recycle when the next bin day is easy to remember

points.text: We will give every household one reminder a week, tied to its own bin day.
The strategy rests on making the habit easy, not on telling people why.
We reach adults aged 25 to 54 in the county through the channels they already use.
Each message is tested against the 8% objective before it runs.
Evidence for the reminder comes from the council's own collection data.
The benefit to the council is a measurable change in recycling by month twelve.
